svg.aria-label: Store queue: the machine behind its exits
svg.text: Store queue: the machine behind its exits
Drawn from the Passages room. A micro-op comes in and takes one exit: a wait, or a step on to the next room. Each exit is a state, and each pair of states has one arc.
a store forwards all of it and an older store is ahead
a store forwards part of it and an older store is ahead
and an older store is ahead
while the store queue is full
until an entry frees in the store queue
Solid arcs rest on measurements or two sources.
Dashed arcs rest on one source or are derived or inferred.
○ forward full: Forwarded from a store
~ wait store address: Wait for an older store's address
○ no older store: No older store to the address
◆ wait full: Wait for a store-queue entry
~ inferred: patent reading or author reasoning
